home.why.privateBody: Only the people in a conversation can read it. The server keeps it as scrambled text.
home.why.encryptedBody: Messages, files, calls and even your settings are locked before they leave your device.
home.why.searchTitle: Search That Stays on Your Device

home.why.safetyBody: Compare a number or scan a code with a friend to make sure nobody is listening in between.

home.why.signupBody: All it takes to sign up is a username and a password.
home.why.adsBody: Nothing about you is sold, and nothing follows you around.
home.why.recoveryBody: If you forget your password, your recovery key gets you back in with all your messages.
home.why.exportBody: Download your messages, servers and friends as a zip whenever you like.
home.why.payBody: Every feature is free for everyone. There's no subscription and no paid tier.
home.why.emojiBody: Use your custom emoji and sticker packs in every server and DM.
home.why.shareBody: Share a window or your whole screen at its own resolution and up to 60 frames a second, with sound.
home.why.filesBody: Send long videos and big files without shrinking them first.
home.why.themesBody: All 20 built-in themes, plus any you make yourself.
home.why.moreBody: Everything you'd expect from a chat app, and a few things you might not.
home.why.notesBody: Type in the same note at the same time and watch each other's words appear.
home.why.subchatsBody: Start a side conversation inside a DM or group, with a password if you like.
home.why.soundsBody: Make Nexa sound the way you like, even with your own recordings.
home.why.pluginsBody: Restyle anything or add new features, right inside the app.

home.notes.lede: Plan a trip, keep a shared list or write a story with friends. Everyone can type in the same note at once, and you can see who's writing where.

home.notes.offlineBody: Keep writing without a connection. Your changes are saved once you're back online.

legal.new1: Servers: staff can now take down a server's icon, banner, name, or description when it breaks the rules. Its owner gets a notice with the reason and a case to answer in. Staff never see what is said inside a server.
legal.new2: Profiles: staff can also clear the nicknames an account uses in its servers.
legal.new3: Case threads can carry pictures and videos, which are not end-to-end encrypted. Once staff close a case, nobody can write in it until they open it again.
legal.new4: Link previews and YouTube videos are fetched by Nexa's server through Cloudflare, so the sites you link never see your address and YouTube never learns who is watching.
legal.hlPrivateBody: Messages, files, and calls are encrypted on your device. Nobody who runs Nexa can read them.
legal.hlStaffBody: Public profiles and images, the delivery details the server needs, and moderation cases. Case threads with Nexa are not end-to-end encrypted.
legal.hlModerationBody: Every action comes with a reason, a notice from Nexa naming who acted, and a private thread to appeal in. All of it is logged.
legal.hlRulesBody: Keep it legal, respect copyright, no gore, no hate or harassment, no impersonation, and no abuse of the service.
legal.hlDataBody: No email, no phone number, nothing sold, nothing tracked. The Privacy Policy lists every field that is kept.

whatsNew.intro: Nexa has been updated. Here is what you can do now.
whatsNew.r20260930.lookBody: Nexa has been redesigned from top to bottom: panels float and catch the light, names and titles have new lettering, and every theme's colours now match wherever they appear. Try the themes in Settings, Appearance.
whatsNew.r20260930.profilesBody: Profiles show names big, take a glow from the banner, and put what someone is playing on a card lit by its album art. Open anyone's profile to see it.
whatsNew.r20260930.spotifyBody: When someone's linked Discord account is playing Spotify, their status now names the artists instead of just saying Spotify.
whatsNew.r202609302.picturesBody: Big pictures sent from now on come with a small copy for the chat, so conversations full of photos show up almost at once. Open a picture to see it at full size.
whatsNew.r202609302.uploadsBody: Files now go up several at a time, and big ones send much faster from the desktop app and Chrome. Pictures you send show in your chat right away, without downloading them back.
whatsNew.r20260926.blockBody: When you block someone, you can hide their messages entirely, and replies to them too. Change it any time in Settings under Blocked Users, where everyone you have blocked is listed.
whatsNew.r20260926.bugsBody: Press the bug button in any conversation, on the Friends page or in Settings to tell the Nexa team what broke, with screenshots or a recording. Their replies arrive in your Nexa conversation.
whatsNew.r20260926.channelIconsBody: A channel can have its own icon in place of the # or speaker: a line icon, any emoji, or one of your server's custom emoji. Pick one in the channel's settings.
whatsNew.r20260926.dmGroupsBody: Sort conversations into named groups with Add to Group in a conversation’s menu. Groups can be pinned and collapsed, and still show what is waiting in them.
whatsNew.r20260926.extendBody: Custom CSS and Plugins have their own pages in Settings, where you add them from a link or as code. They are made by other people, not by Nexa, and a plugin can read your messages, so only add ones you trust.
whatsNew.r20260926.foldersBody: Drag a server onto another to make a folder, or choose Add to Folder in a server’s menu. A folder’s menu lets you name it and pick its colour.
whatsNew.r20260926.formattingBody: Press Format Text beside the emoji button to style a message the way you would in a document, on phones too. Messages can now have coloured text, tables, task lists, callouts, highlights and collapsible sections.
whatsNew.r20260926.friendsBody: Profiles show a friend request you have sent, with a way to cancel it, and let you accept or ignore one sent to you. Click anywhere on a friend in your list to open their profile.
whatsNew.r20260926.invitesBody: A link to Nexa in a message now opens right here instead of in a new tab. Invites show the server's banner, who is online, and a button to join.
whatsNew.r20260926.invitesTitle: Invites and Links Open in the App
whatsNew.r20260926.nexaBody: The Nexa conversation now sorts by date with your other conversations, and you can close it like any DM. It comes back when Nexa has something new for you.
whatsNew.r20260926.pinsBody: Pin servers, folders and conversations from their menu. They stay at the top of their list, even when you join a new server.
whatsNew.r20260926.searchBody: The search box above a conversation now searches just that conversation, and “Find or start a conversation” (Ctrl+K) searches everything, with tabs for messages, media, links and files. Your messages are decrypted and indexed on this device only.
whatsNew.r20260926.soloGroupBody: Press Create Group in Select Friends with nobody picked to make a group, then add friends whenever you like.
whatsNew.r20260926.soloGroupTitle: Start a Group on Your Own
whatsNew.r20260926.themesBody: Pick one of 16 new colour themes in Settings under Appearance, or build your own in Simple or Advanced mode. Nexa keeps every piece of text readable.
whatsNew.r20260926.updatesBody: When a new version of Nexa is ready, a prompt in the middle of the screen asks you to reload or update, and it waits for any call, upload or download to finish first.
whatsNew.r20260926.updatesTitle: Know When an Update Is Ready
whatsNew.r202609262.dmPrivacyBody: By default, only your friends and people you share a server with can start a conversation with you now. Anyone else can send you a friend request, and you can change this in Settings under Privacy & Safety.
whatsNew.r202609262.quietDMBody: Opening a conversation with someone no longer puts it in their list. They see it when you send your first message or call them.
whatsNew.r202609262.quietDMTitle: New Conversations Wait for Your First Message
whatsNew.r202609263.stickersBody: The sticker picker fills in faster, even on a slow phone or connection, and shows your stickers at once when you open it again. A sticker that can't load says so and tries again by itself.
whatsNew.r202609264.webhooksBody: Let other programs post in your channels, with rich embeds, link buttons, polls and files. Make a webhook in Server Settings under Integrations and give its URL to the program.
whatsNew.r20260927.groupsBody: Invite People in a group chat now lists your friends, to add in one tap. To join groups only from a link someone sends you, turn off “Let friends add me to group chats” in Settings, Privacy & Safety.
whatsNew.r20260927.metadataBody: Photos and videos you send no longer carry hidden details, such as where they were taken or which phone took them. These details are removed on your device before anything is sent, and the quality stays the same.
whatsNew.r20260927.metadataTitle: No Hidden Details in Photos and Videos
whatsNew.r20260927.notesBody: Add Friend now lets you write a short note, so people know who is asking. Only the person you add can read it.
whatsNew.r20260927.notesTitle: Add a Note to Friend Requests
whatsNew.r20260927.pollsBody: Tap the plus button in the message box and choose Create Poll to ask a question with up to ten answers. Polls are end-to-end encrypted, and server owners choose who can make them.
whatsNew.r202609272.aboutMeBody: Your About Me has the message box's tools now: the formatting editor, emoji, shortcuts like Ctrl+B and spell check. It shows all the formatting a message can.
whatsNew.r202609272.aboutMeTitle: Write Your About Me Like a Message
whatsNew.r202609272.copyBody: Selecting text in a message now takes its emoji along, even when you start on an emoji or the message is nothing but emoji.
whatsNew.r202609272.emojiBody: Point at an emoji in a message, or tap it on a phone, to see it bigger with the :name: that types it. A custom emoji also says which server or pack it comes from.
whatsNew.r202609272.gridBody: Two or more pictures in one message now sit together in a tidy grid. Open any of them to see it whole.
whatsNew.r202609272.layoutBody: The server list, the conversation list and the chat each have their own shade now, with clearer edges, gentler highlights when someone mentions you and tooltips in the colours around them. It works with every theme, including the ones you make.
whatsNew.r202609272.previewsBody: Previews now show the site's icon and who wrote the page and when, keep a post's line breaks and make its links clickable. Links from Reddit, TikTok and IMDb get proper previews too, and long descriptions fold behind Show More.
whatsNew.r202609272.repliesBody: The message box shows the message you are replying to, and the line over a reply keeps its formatting, like bold, underline, colours and emoji.
whatsNew.r202609272.sendButtonBody: Right-click the message box and choose Show Send Message Button to put a Send button beside it. The same switch is in Settings, Appearance.
whatsNew.r202609272.sendPreviewBody: Press the eye beside the message box to see your message as it will look once sent. Only you can see the preview.
whatsNew.r202609272.spellingBody: With Nexa in English on a computer, Nexa now checks your spelling itself, with American and British dictionaries. Right-click an underlined word for suggestions or to add it to your dictionary, and find the words you added in Settings, Appearance.
whatsNew.r202609272.textMenuBody: Right-click any text box on a computer for Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo and Select All, plus a Format menu wherever formatting works. Hold Shift as you right-click for your browser's own menu.
whatsNew.r202609272.typingBody: Type an emoji's :name: and it becomes the emoji the moment you add the closing colon, so the message box shows what you are about to send.
whatsNew.r202609292.callsBody: Voices used to fall most of a second behind after every pause. Now they come through almost as soon as they are spoken, and they sound fuller too.
whatsNew.r202609292.emojiBody: Type : to see the emoji you use most, or a few letters to find the one you usually pick, even from the middle of a name. You can turn it off in Settings, Appearance.
whatsNew.r202609292.pinsBody: Pinned messages now look the way they do in the conversation, with every line, picture and file. Jump takes you straight to one.
whatsNew.r202609292.themesBody: The classic themes trade flat grey for a soft violet tint. The light theme also gets crisp tooltips and dialogs that stand clearly above the page.
whatsNew.r20260929.activityBody: Sharing your activity, Discord and the desktop app's Rich Presence now live together in Settings, Activity.
whatsNew.r20260929.discordBody: Connect your Discord account in Settings, Activity, and the song you're listening to or the game you're playing on Discord shows under your name.
whatsNew.r20260929.homeBody: The Nexa button only counts friend requests now. Conversations with new messages still show under it with their own counts.
whatsNew.r20260929.phoneBody: On a phone, formatting, the message preview and emoji are behind the ^ button beside the message box.
whatsNew.r20260929.phoneTitle: More Room to Type on Phones
whatsNew.r202609303.fontBody: Nexa is set in Wix Madefor now, rounder and easier to read. To go back to the old letters, pick Classic in Settings, Appearance, Font.
whatsNew.r202609303.liveBody: Everyone in a note sees the words appear as they are typed, with each person's cursor and selection in their own colour. Earlier versions wait in Version History, to look back at or restore.
whatsNew.r202609303.notesBody: Write notes with pictures and files anywhere in them, encrypted like your messages. Find them under Friends, and share one with a request or a link.
whatsNew.r202609303.phoneBody: Panels like the emoji picker pull up to full height or swipe away, the keyboard stays up after you send, and nothing you edit hides behind it.
whatsNew.r202609303.pickBody: Ctrl-click conversations, friends, servers and members to act on all of them together, or press and hold on a phone. Drag conversations to put them in any order.
whatsNew.r202609303.postsBody: Links to X, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, Telegram, Threads and Mastodon show the post itself, with its pictures, and videos that play right in the chat.
whatsNew.r202609303.rolesBody: A profile opened inside a server shows the roles that person has there.
whatsNew.r202609303.settingsBody: Settings are grouped into clearer pages, and the search box at the top finds any one of them and takes you straight to it.
whatsNew.r20261001.casesBody: You can now send pictures and videos in a case with the moderation team. When the team closes a case, it can't be written in until they open it again.
whatsNew.r20261001.phoneBody: Videos and link previews stay inside the screen on a phone instead of pushing the whole chat sideways.
whatsNew.r20261001.removeBody: Point at a link preview and press the x to take the previews off your message. Moderators can do it on any message, and the message's menu brings them back.
whatsNew.r20261001.serversBody: A server's name, icon, banner and description are public, so they follow the same rules as profiles. If one breaks them, its owner gets a notice from Nexa saying why.
whatsNew.r20261001.youtubeBody: A YouTube link now shows the channel, its views, likes, length and date, and plays right in the chat. It plays through Nexa, so YouTube never learns who is watching.
whatsNew.r202610022.streamBody: Videos now play as soon as their first part arrives, however big they are, and skipping ahead loads only from there, still end-to-end encrypted. Safari and iPhones still load the whole video first for now.
whatsNew.r202610022.friendSoundBody: Friend requests have a sound of their own now. Change it or switch it off in Settings, Sounds.
whatsNew.r20261002.expressionsBody: Sticker packs and emoji are pictures anyone can be shown, so they follow the same rules as profiles. If one breaks them, its owner gets a notice from Nexa saying which and why.
whatsNew.r20261002.expressionsTitle: Stickers and Emoji Follow the Rules Too
whatsNew.r20261002.noiseBody: Enhanced noise suppression (RNNoise) now takes keyboards, fans and background noise out of your voice on your own device. Switch to Standard or Off from the button beside hang-up, or from the microphone's menu in a call.
whatsNew.r20261002.orderBody: Your conversation list always goes by recent activity now. Drag one to move it, and it stays where you put it until something new happens in it.
whatsNew.r20261002.profileBody: Copy Profile Link on any profile, yours included, for a link that shows the profile to anyone, even without an account. Sent in a chat, it becomes the person's card.
whatsNew.r20261002.sensitivityBody: In Voice & Video settings, the input sensitivity slider now shows your voice as you talk. It turns green when your voice is loud enough to be sent, so you can set the handle just above the noise in your room.
whatsNew.r20261002.sensitivityTitle: See Your Voice on the Sensitivity Slider
whatsNew.title: What's New
whatsNew.r202610012.moveBody: Nexa has a new address, nexa.fish, and it works at mathtest.lol too. The old address brings you over still signed in, and the desktop app moves with its next update.
whatsNew.r202610012.notesBody: People can type in the same line at once without letters going missing or showing up twice. Drag a picture's edges to resize it, or drag one in straight from a website.
whatsNew.r202610012.soundsBody: Make a sound pack from your own recordings in Settings, Sounds. Your packs follow you to every device.
whatsNew.r202610012.dockBody: Your profile, status and call controls now run along the bottom of the server list and the sidebar together, so less gets cut off.

serverTag.page.uploadHint: Or put up a picture of your own. Moving ones keep moving, and every picture is cut to a square.

serverTag.page.someRolesHint: People who manage the server can always wear it.

serverTag.page.joinHint: Anyone who presses the tag can join your server. An invite link is kept for it, which you'll find in Invites.
serverTag.page.previewMessage: This is how the tag looks beside a name.
serverTag.page.removeBody: It comes off everyone wearing it.

serverTag.choose.hint: Wear one of your servers' tags next to your name, everywhere it's shown.
serverTag.choose.noneToWear: None of your servers has a tag yet. A server's admins can make one in Server Settings.

whatsNew.r202610023.widgetsBody: Show your favourite game, what you're playing now, what you want to play and what you've played, or make cards of your own. Add them in Settings, Profiles.
whatsNew.r202610023.tagsBody: A server's admins can give it a tag of up to four letters with a badge, even a moving picture. Members wear it next to their name everywhere, and anyone can open it to see the server and join.
whatsNew.r202610023.typingBody: Pick up to three emoji, how they move and the words after your name while you type. Set it up in Settings, Profiles.
whatsNew.r202610023.keybindsBody: Choose your own keys for mute, deafen and sharing your activity in Settings, Keybinds. In the desktop app they work even while Nexa is in the background.
whatsNew.r202610023.activityTitle: Hide Your Activity in One Click
whatsNew.r202610023.activityBody: The new button beside deafen stops sharing what you're playing, and one more click shares it again.
whatsNew.r202610023.railBody: Dragging servers into and out of folders now works wherever you let go, gaps included.
profile.tabs.label: Profile Sections
profile.tabs.noActivity: {name} isn't playing or listening to anything right now.
profile.tabs.noActivityOwn: When you play something or listen to music with activity sharing on, it shows here.
whatsNew.r202610023.profileBody: Full profiles open wide now, with the person on the left and their widgets, what they're doing and what you have in common on tabs, so a long profile never runs off the screen.
designer.intro: Click any part of your profile to change it.
designer.view.label: Show Your Profile As
designer.caption.full: Your whole profile, as View Full Profile opens it.
designer.caption.card: What people see when they click your name or picture.
designer.caption.chat: Your name and tag in a conversation, and how you look while you type.
designer.spot.name: Edit Name
designer.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 10 MB. Moving pictures move for everyone.
designer.card.title: Widget on Your Card
designer.card.hint: Your card shows one widget: the first one on your full profile. Pick which.
designer.card.none: Add a widget and your first one shows here.
designer.chat.theirs: anyone up for a round later?
typing.editor.emojiHint: Emoji, server emoji or pictures of your own. Moving pictures keep moving.
whatsNew.r202610024.designerTitle: A Profile Editor You Can Click
whatsNew.r202610024.designerBody: Settings, Profiles now shows your whole profile. Click any part of it to change it, and see your profile card and how you look in chat as you go.
whatsNew.r202610024.cardBody: Clicking a name or a picture opens someone's profile card again, with View Full Profile for everything else.
whatsNew.r202610024.typingBody: Your typing indicator can use pictures of your own, moving ones too, cropped to fit.
whatsNew.r202610024.tagsBody: A server tag can have up to eight letters now.
whatsNew.r202610024.zalgoBody: Text buried under stacked marks can't be typed or pasted anymore, and older messages with it are tidied so they stay on their line.
whatsNew.r202610025.popoutBody: Click a name or a picture and a small profile opens right next to it. You can message them from there, or open their full profile.
whatsNew.r202610025.rolesBody: In a server, profiles show the person's roles. If you can manage roles, add one with the + or take one off with its x.
widgets.about.artists: The artists you could listen to all day, up to twelve.
widgets.about.albums: The albums you know by heart, up to twelve.
widgets.about.songs: The songs you never skip, up to ten.

widgets.music.placeholder.albums: An album, or its artist or one of its songs
widgets.music.placeholder.songs: A song, or its artist or album

widgets.music.noResults: Nothing matches that. You can add it by name.
widgets.music.noneYet: Search above and pick the ones to show.
whatsNew.r202610026.musicBody: Show your favourite artists, albums and songs, and find them however you remember them: type a song to find who made it, or an album to find its songs. Add them in Settings, Profiles.
widgets.music.noPreview: There's no preview of this song.
widgets.music.previewFailed: Couldn't play the preview. Try again in a moment.
whatsNew.r202610027.previewsBody: Press a song in someone's Favourite Songs to hear 30 seconds of it right there. The arrow beside it opens the whole song on Deezer.
whatsNew.r202610028.linksBody: A link to someone's profile now shows the card you get by clicking their name, with what they're up to, their first widget and a box to message them. Opening the link itself still shows their whole profile.
whatsNew.r202610028.androidBody: Nexa now has an app for Android phones, with notifications, calls and gestures made for touch. Get it from the download page, or from the banner on your phone.
